text: ggicons package lets visualise data icons ggplot2. draws vector icons icons package directly ggplot2 plot. Icons can mapped data drawn like points, placed fixed positions annotations, substituted axis, strip legend labels (styled colour, size, alpha angle aesthetics).

title: Icon Geometries for ggplot2
text: geom_icon() draws icon per row (x, y), place point. Map icon vector icons package (e.g. icons::fontawesome$solid$rocket) icon aesthetic, style usual colour, size, alpha angle aesthetics:
code: df <- data.frame(   x = 1:3, y = c(1, 3, 2),   icon = c(     fontawesome$solid$rocket,     fontawesome$solid$star,     fontawesome$solid$heart   ) ) ggplot(df, aes(x, y, icon = icon)) +   geom_icon(size = 12, colour = "steelblue")

title: Icon Geometries for ggplot2
text: icon aesthetic already mapped icon values, scale_icon_identity() passes unchanged. map discrete data column (e.g. category) icon instead, use scale_icon_manual(). ’s automatic discrete palette icons, values always required:  Icons drawn geom_icon() also appear legend key glyph, via draw_key_icon(), legend shows actual icon shape instead generic point.
code: df <- data.frame(   x = 1:3, y = c(1, 3, 2),   type = c("rocket", "star", "heart") ) ggplot(df, aes(x, y, icon = type, colour = type)) +   geom_icon(size = 12) +   scale_icon_manual(values = c(     fontawesome$solid$rocket,     fontawesome$solid$star,     fontawesome$solid$heart   )) +   scale_colour_manual(values = c("steelblue", "goldenrod", "firebrick"))

what: Annotate a plot with icons at fixed positions — annotation_icon
title: Annotate a plot with icons at fixed positions — annotation_icon
text: annotation_icon() draws one icons fixed (x, y) positions, icon analogue ggplot2::annotation_custom() / ggplot2::annotation_raster(): single call adds icons directly, without data frame aes() mapping. Unlike , though, annotation_icon() train panel's position scales, since fixed-position icon usefully treated like point annotation (e.g. ggplot2::annotate()) like arbitrary grob pinned panel's corners, placing one outside data's range still expands axes fit .

title: ggicons: Icon Geometries for 'ggplot2' — ggicons-package
text: Provides icon geometries 'ggplot2', using vector icon sets 'icons' package. geom_icon() draws icon per row place point, styled usual colour, size, alpha angle aesthetics. Icon data passed straight scale_icon_identity(), mapped discrete values scale_icon_manual(). Icons also appear legend keys, fixed-position markers annotation_icon(), axis, strip legend labels via element_icon() theme element.

text: Two modes, chosen whether n (nrow ncol) set: Fixed grid (n, nrow/ncol, given): grid always n slots; round(value / symbol_value) marked filled (capped n), rest empty. waffle-chart/rating-widget shape — proportions vary, grid footprint . Growing grid (n, nrow ncol left NULL, one nrow/ncol given): grid exactly round(value / symbol_value) slots, filled — isotype/unit-chart shape icons value, footprint grows . Either way, one nrow/ncol needs setting; wraps fit. neither set, grid defaults single row, unless x/y asks bar/column shape instead - see Orientation .

title: Pictogram grid layout — stat_pictogram
text: x y grid's anchor, value actually required. Map get fixed-position grid, centred (x, y) - waffle chart rating widget. Leave one unmapped becomes growth axis bar-style stack, anchored edge plot panel rather data value (unmapped axis gets position scale - see geom_pictogram()'s hjust/vjust), way geom_bar() requires x: aes(x = category, value = count) draws column chart, one growing column per category, bottom panel; aes(y = category, value = count) draws horizontal bar, growing right left panel. neither nrow ncol set, missing axis also one grows instead wraps (single column column chart, single row bar).

title: ggicons (development version)
text: Initial CRAN submission. Added geom_icon(), =geom draws icon per row icon aesthetic, styled colour/fill, size, alpha angle. icon aesthetic takes icon vector icons package directly (e.g. icons::fontawesome$solid$rocket). Added draw_key_icon(), default geom_icon() legend key glyph. Added scale_icon_identity() scale_icon_manual(), plus scale_type.icon() method aes(icon = ...) picks sensible scale. Added annotation_icon(), drawing one icons fixed positions, recycled way annotate() recycles arguments. Added element_icon(), theme() element (parallel element_text()) axis.text/strip.text/legend.text draws label matching name supplied icons lookup icon, falling back ordinary text everything else.
